# Msty Studio Docs

> Guides for Msty Studio 3.x Desktop, with the preserved 2.x documentation available separately.

The default documentation covers Msty Studio 3.x Desktop. Msty Studio Web remains on 2.x; use the 2.x guides for that version. Do not apply 3.x interface instructions to 2.x.

## 3.x Desktop docs (default)

- [Msty Studio 3.x](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/getting-started): Start with a model, then build your workflow.
- [Quick Start](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/getting-started/quick-start): Go from a clean installation to your first conversation.
- [Install and Upgrade](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/getting-started/install-and-upgrade): Install the desktop app or move from 2.x to 3.x.
- [Find Your Way](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/getting-started/find-your-way): The sidebar, new conversation menu, and search.
- [Choose and Connect Models](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models): Add an online provider, install a local model, or connect an existing model server.
- [Online Providers](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/online-providers): Connect an API provider and choose the models available in Msty Studio.
- [Local Models](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/local-models): Discover, install, and manage models running on your computer.
- [Import Models](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/import-models): Use a local GGUF file or a compatible safetensors model directory.
- [External Model Servers](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/external-servers): Connect models served by Ollama, LM Studio, or another compatible endpoint.
- [Model Parameters](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/model-parameters): Adjust response settings, thinking effort, and reusable parameter presets.
- [Model Matchmaker](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/model-matchmaker): Rank models against the strengths and tradeoffs that matter for your task.
- [Vibe CLI Proxy](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/managing-models/vibe-cli-proxy): Connect supported coding assistant accounts and use their available models in Msty Studio.
- [Start a conversation](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations): Choose a model, send a prompt, and organize your chats.
- [Compare models with split chats](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations/split-chat): Send one prompt to several models or explore separate threads side by side.
- [Edit responses and explore branches](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations/responses-and-branches): Revise messages, generate alternatives, and return to earlier paths.
- [Reuse prompts and instructions](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations/prompts): Set a system prompt and insert saved Quick Prompts while composing.
- [Chat with personas and crews](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations/personas-and-crews): Use a configured assistant or bring several personas into one conversation.
- [Observe chats with Shadow Personas](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations/shadow-personas): Generate a separate summary or analysis from selected conversation splits.
- [Export and import conversations](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/conversations/export-import): Save a whole conversation or export one split and its branches.
- [Set up Agent Mode](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/agent-mode): Connect a coding agent or Local AI and start a task in a folder.
- [Manage agent sessions and permissions](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/agent-mode/sessions-and-permissions): Review tool requests, inspect results, and resume earlier work.
- [Personas](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/personas): Create reusable assistant personas and organize how they work.
- [Prompts](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/prompts): Save prompts, fill variables, and test revisions before using them.
- [Skills](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/skills): Create and install reusable task instructions for agents.
- [Context Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/context-studio): Keep reusable files, images, websites, and transcripts ready for your work.
- [Media Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/media-studio): Generate images or videos and refine them with reference context.
- [Create a Knowledge Stack](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/knowledge-stacks/overview): Prepare your own sources for use in conversations.
- [Add and update sources](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/knowledge-stacks/sources): Choose what a Knowledge Stack indexes and how it handles changes.
- [Query Settings](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/knowledge-stacks/query-settings): Control how a Knowledge Stack supplies context to the model.
- [Manage, share, and migrate stacks](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/knowledge-stacks/manage-and-migrate): Export stacks, rebuild indexes, and work with Classic stacks.
- [Connect MCP tools](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/toolbox/tools): Add an MCP server and test the tools it provides.
- [Build a toolset](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/toolbox/toolsets): Group tools and select the capabilities a conversation can use.
- [Live Contexts](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/toolbox/live-contexts): Bring data from an HTTP endpoint into a conversation.
- [Turnstiles](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/add-ons/turnstiles): Run a reusable sequence of prompts and conversation actions.
- [Real-Time Data](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/add-ons/real-time-data): Search for current information while chatting.
- [Add attachments](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/add-ons/attachments): Give a conversation documents, images, pages, or video transcripts.
- [Workspaces and projects](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/workspaces): Separate your work and organize related conversations.
- [Environments](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/workspaces/environment): Save named sets of variables for your workflows.
- [Settings](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/settings/settings): Find app preferences, providers, models, and data controls.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts and Command Palette](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/settings/keyboard-shortcuts): Find actions quickly and customize their key bindings.
- [Back up and restore data](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/settings/data-backups): Export your data, recover a backup, and manage desktop storage.
- [Remote Tools](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/v3/settings/remote-connections): Make desktop tools and local models available to a remote Msty connection.

- [3.x documentation text](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/studio-docs.txt): Combined export of only the 3.x guides.

## 2.x docs

- [Welcome to Msty Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/getting-started): The complete guide to Msty Studio
- [Quick Start](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/getting-started/quick-start): Get started with Msty Studio in a few easy steps
- [Download Msty Studio Desktop](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/getting-started/download): Download Msty Studio Desktop for Windows, Mac, or Linux
- [Managing Models](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models): Add and manage AI models in Msty Studio
- [Online Providers](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/online-providers): Connect hosted AI providers and manage cloud model access
- [Local Models](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/local-models): Install, import, and run local AI models in Msty Studio Desktop
- [Vibe CLI Proxy](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/vibe-cli-proxy): Connect command-line model providers to use their AI models
- [Model Matchmaker](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/model-matchmaker): Find the best model for your task using ranked recommendations
- [Image Generation](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/image-gen): Image generation with compatible models
- [Insights](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/insights): View insights into token usage for your models
- [Advanced Configs](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/advanced-configs): Configure model parameters and advanced settings
- [Thinking Effort](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/thinking-effort): Enhance your AI's reasoning with advanced thinking effort configurations.
- [Context Explorer](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/managing-models/context-explorer): Understand context windows, memory usage, and model fit
- [Conversations](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/main-chat): Conversations done right
- [Persona Conversations](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/persona-conversations): Chat with a selected persona in a dedicated conversation
- [Shadow Persona](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/shadow-personas): How to set up a Shadow Persona
- [Crew Conversations](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/crew-chats): Chat with your crews
- [Responses](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/responses): Manage responses with ease
- [Split Chat](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/split-chat): Split chats and find the best model
- [Forge Mode](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/forge-mode): Transform content creation with Forge Mode's powerful editing tools
- [System Prompt Modes](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/system-prompts): Define how custom prompts interact with the system prompt.
- [Branch Explorer](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/branch-explorer): Navigate and compare branches easily
- [Conversation Export and Import](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/conversations/export-import): Move conversations and their attachments between Msty Studio workspaces
- [Agent Mode](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/agent-mode/agent-mode): Run coding agents in Msty Studio Desktop
- [Persona Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/studios/persona-studio): Build Assistant and User Personas in Persona Studio
- [Prompt Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/studios/prompts-studio): Prompt Studio helps you create, organize, and manage your prompts efficiently
- [Skills Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/studios/skills-studio): Build, organize, and install agent skills
- [Media Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/studios/media-studio): Create and refine images and videos with context-aware generation workflows
- [Context Studio](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/studios/context-studio): Build a reusable library of files, webpages, YouTube links, and media for conversations and creative work
- [Overview](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/overview): Get started with Knowledge Stacks in Msty
- [Compose Options](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/compose-options): Learn how to compose Knowledge Stacks
- [Query Settings](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/query-settings): Learn how to optimize query settings for Knowledge Stacks
- [Chunks Visualizer](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/chunks-visualizer): Visualize how your documents were converted into chunks
- [Chunks Console](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/chunks-console): Test queries and resulting chunks
- [Analytics and Insights](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/analytics-insights): See how your Knowledge Stacks are performing and how you can optimize results
- [Share and Manage](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/share-and-manage): Learn how to organize Knowledge Stacks and share them with others
- [Ignore File](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/ignore-file): Learn how to use an ignore file to have Msty ignore files in a folder
- [Knowledge Stacks Next Gen](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/knowledge-stacks/next-gen): Explore the next generation of Knowledge Stacks in Msty Studio with new source types, smarter retrieval, and an improved experience.
- [Tools](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/toolbox/tools): Empower Msty Studio with tools in your toolbox
- [Toolsets](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/toolbox/toolsets): Empower Msty Studio with toolsets in your toolbox
- [Live Contexts](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/toolbox/live-contexts): Empower Msty Studio with Live Contexts in your toolbox
- [Tool Dependencies](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/toolbox/tool-dependencies): Configure dependencies for your tools on different platforms
- [Turnstiles](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/add-ons/turnstiles): Build reusable multi-step AI workflows with queueing, branching, loops, and checkpoints
- [Real-Time Data](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/add-ons/real-time-data): Bring the latest information into your conversations
- [Attachments](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/add-ons/attachments): Enhance your chats with documents, images, websites, and YouTube link attachments
- [Workspaces](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/workspaces): Organize your work with workspaces
- [Organize](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/workspaces/organize): Organize your projects and conversations
- [Environments](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/workspaces/environment): Create and manage environments for your needs
- [Workspace Lock and Secrets Encryption](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/workspaces/lock-and-encryption): Protect your workspaces and sensitive keys
- [Settings](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/settings): Configure appearance, services, and app behavior in Msty Studio
- [Modes](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/modes): Enable the mode that fits the task (or your mood)
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/keyboard-shortcuts): Customize keyboard controls in Msty Studio
- [Command Palette](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/command-palette): Quickly run actions and navigate Msty Studio
- [Default Prompts](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/default-prompts): Edit the default prompts for various features in Msty Studio
- [Remote Connections](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/remote-connections): Connect remotely to Msty Studio Desktop
- [Data Backups and Restoration](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/data-backups): Backup and restore your data
- [Lost & Found](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/settings/lost-and-found): Discover and recover lost or orphaned workspaces using the Lost & Found.

- [Manage Users](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/enterprise/users): Invite and manage users
- [Manage Teams](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/enterprise/teams): Manage teams and what they can access in Msty Studio

- [Sharing](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/enterprise/sharing): Share and collaborate with your teams in Msty Studio
- [Audit Log](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/enterprise/audit-log): View important user and team management-level actions in your Enterprise plan
- [Manage License](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/how-tos/manage-license): How to your manage licenses and devices
- [Find Online Model API Keys](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/how-tos/find-api-keys): How to find API keys for various Online AI services

- [Amazon Bedrock](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/how-tos/aws-bedrock): How to set up Amazon Bedrock with Msty Studio

- [Setup Tailscale for Sidecar](https://docs.msty.ai/studio/how-tos/setup-tailscale-for-sidecar): How to setup a Tailscale network for Sidecar
